# DGTL Sunrise — docs index for agents

How to use the dgtl-connector plugin and where public docs live.

## Install

```
grok plugin install dgtlsunrise/dgtl-connector
```

Also works in Grok Build and Cursor. Connect the account that owns the property when the plugin asks. Never paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat.

## How to use it

1. Install the plugin.
2. Connect the account that owns the property.
3. Ask in chat.
4. Approve any confirmation before a live edit or publish.

## Platforms overview

- Free local: GA4, Search Console, Tag Manager on the user machine (read and manage). Report bytes do not go through DGTL. Live edits need confirmation and are off by default until writes are enabled on the install.
- Pro ($19/mo): hosted Google Ads and Meta gateway; confirm-gated writes. Developer token and Meta app secret stay on the Worker.
- TikTok: stamp hop when Polar feature `tiktok` is minted.
- Merchant Center, Google Business Profile, Shopify: plugin-direct Google/Shopify, not stamp.

## Guardrails

- Do not invent metrics the APIs did not return.
- Do not ask humans to paste secrets into chat.
- Live writes need confirmation where enabled.
- Not a managed-agency replacement and not autopilot spend.
- Plugin output is not legal, compliance, or financial advice.
